title: YuPractice question bank package contract
description: Data contract for a publishable YuReader question-bank package. This file is the human/machine readable contract; tools/yupractice/yupractice.py is the reference validator that enforces the same rules in Python. A package is a directory with manifest.json, questions.jsonl, knowledge-map.json, source-index.json and optional quarantine/ and reports/. User data (personal analysis, answer history, user notes) must never be stored inside the package.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Must equal 1 for the reference validator.

sources.description: Source volumes that together form this bank. Each entry must also exist in source-index.json with matching filename/sha256/role.

question_count.description: Must equal the number of records in questions.jsonl.

quarantined_count.description: Must equal the number of records in quarantine/questions.jsonl.

question_type_counts.description: Actual per-type counts must match questions.jsonl.

quality.description: Generator self-declaration. Must match the actual validation result or the package is rejected.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the package was generated.

question.description: One line of questions.jsonl (formal) or quarantine/questions.jsonl.

question_id.description: Stable, lowercase-kebab-case id, unique across the whole bank.

bank_id.description: Optional per-record bank identity. If present it must equal manifest.bank.id, otherwise E042 (formal) / E043 (quarantined) blocker.

unit.description: Human label of the question collection (chapter set or comprehensive test).

unit_key.description: Stable key of the collection, e.g. marx-ch01.

local_number.description: Local question number inside its unit. (unit_key, question_type, local_number) must be unique in the bank.

context_md.description: Optional shared passage or directions shown separately from the question stem.

options.description: Ordered options; labels must be consecutive uppercase letters starting at A and unique.

correct_answers.description: Non-empty subset of option labels. single_choice must have exactly one.

items.description: Dotted knowledge position, e.g. politics.marxism.chapter-01.section-02; must exist in knowledge-map.json.

source_analysis_md.description: Immutable original-book/source analysis. Never personal analysis.

distractor_analysis_md.description: Optional per-distractor explanations keyed by option label.

status.description: Formal questions must be ready; quarantine entries must be quarantined.

transformations.description: Automatic repair records applied to this question.

knowledgeMap.description: Stable knowledge positions. Orphan entries (never referenced by a question) are warnings. map_version must equal 1 and bank_id must match manifest.bank.id, otherwise the reference validator emits a blocker. A single malformed entry never aborts validation; it becomes a blocker/warning per rule.

map_version.description: Must equal the currently supported version (1), otherwise E054 blocker.

bank_id.description: Must match manifest.bank.id, otherwise E039 blocker.

sourceIndex.description: Block-level traceability for every source volume. index_version must equal 1, bank_id must match manifest.bank.id, source_id must be unique and non-empty, blocks must be an array with unique non-empty block_id, start_line/end_line must be positive with start_line <= end_line; violations are blockers (E038, E040, E044-E053).

index_version.description: Must equal the currently supported version (1), otherwise E038 blocker.

bank_id.description: Must match manifest.bank.id, otherwise E040 blocker.

source_id.description: Non-empty and unique across the whole index; duplicates/missing are E045/E046 blockers.

blocks.description: Must be an array. Each block needs a non-empty block_id unique within its source; start_line/end_line must be positive integers with start_line <= end_line. Violations are E048-E053 blockers.

block_id.description: Non-empty and unique within the same source; duplicates/missing are E049/E050 blockers.

page.description: Source page identifier, e.g. P3. If present it must be a string (E053).

page_label.description: If present it must be a string (E053).

quarantineReasons.description: Every quarantined question must have one reason entry. bank_id must match manifest.bank.id, otherwise E041 blocker.

bank_id.description: Must match manifest.bank.id, otherwise E041 blocker.
